title: Deleting an unused Part Library entry asks and confirms in Part Library words
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Part Library entry {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-DELENTRY-01) has nothing behind it ("Total parts" 0), so it may be deleted.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  2. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the {Part-A} row.
  4. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  5. Look at the bottom left of the window.
  6. Click Delete.
  7. Read the confirmation question.
  8. Confirm the deletion.
  9. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  10. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: The "Edit Library Part" window opens.
  • Step 5: A Delete button sits at the bottom left of the window, and it is enabled, because no part uses the entry.
  • Step 7: The confirmation asks "Are you sure you want to delete this library part?"
  • Step 8: The entry is deleted and a success message reads "Library part deleted successfully."
  • Step 10: {Part-A} is no longer listed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library); story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S12-R13, S12-R5, S11-R3, S11-R3c, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.2 (An entry opens its detail page), 13 Oct copy. QA lead's 9 Oct set-up answer 4. Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 12). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R13: “Deleting a Part Library entry asks "Are you sure you want to delete this library part?"”
  • S12-R5: “The success message when deleting a Part Library entry reads "Library part deleted successfully."”
  • S11-R3: “Clicking a row opens that entry's detail page. The pencil beside the entry's name opens the "Edit Library Part" window, where the entry is edited and where its Delete button sits, bottom left. The detail page itself has no Delete button.”
  • S11-R3c: “While a part still uses the entry, the Delete button is disabled and hovering it shows "Part cannot be deleted. Please delete related parts first."”
